text: Semi-nomadic means a house that comes apart, not a caravan you tow away on a whim.
My working estimate is two days at the quick end, up to two weeks for something large or heavily layered.
That is a burst of work: disassemble, transport, reassemble, connect.
You spend that effort when a move is worth it.
The rest of the time, you are living in a house.
A different park, city, or state becomes possible without leaving the house behind.
Site agreements still matter, but the improvements to your home travel with you.
